study: Sensor contribution to individualized turbofan lifetime estimates
scope: New development experiment on historically inspected train subsets; does not amend gates.json. No official test files. Data and compute: campus-h3 /home/user/rulb.
outer: Reuse IDA engine-level folds, KFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=20261104). One paired seed 101. All four train subsets. FD002 primary, FD004 replication; FD001 and FD003 descriptive.
fit: PE backbone, 50-cycle window, cap 125, train stride 5 starting at cycle 50, all validation windows. Exactly 24 epochs, fixed final checkpoint, batch 256, 1e-3 AdamW, cosine schedule, original asymmetrically weighted loss. No outer-epoch selection or hyperparameter rescue.
variants: OPS: PE plus HGB age and prefix operating conditions
FULL: PE plus identical HGB with sensor measurements added
CET: published CET-MSA architecture adapted to matched window/cap/folds and training budget; official 17-channel inputs, train-only normalization and handcrafted features
prior: Use cutoff grid 50:10:200 inclusive, including an observable terminal cutoff. Only observed prefix required at inference, independent of future length. Same HGB settings as IDA, one deterministic point predictor, matched two-dimensional injection [mu/250,0]. Inner four-fold engine OOF priors, independently fitted scaler and HGB in each inner fit. Equal-engine training row weights. Backbones still use measured signals in OPS and FULL.
primary: FULL minus OPS engine-balanced window RMSE, paired 5000 engine bootstrap seed 99. Pass only CI upper <0 in FD002; same criterion in FD004 for replication. Also report FULL vs M0. Primary evidence = single seed development contrast.
innovation: Only if primary and replication pass: evaluate RESID, two-dimensional injection [reference age/condition lifetime, sensor residual correction]/250. Each inner/outer fit trains sensor residual on engine-out-of-fold reference predictions within its training partition. Same architecture/budget. Keep only if RESID vs FULL CI upper <0 in FD002 and FD004. Otherwise retain simpler comparison and stop.
secondary: Signed bias (pred-true) for bottom quartile total lifetime: threshold calculated within outer training engines separately per fold. Full-minus-OPS change in absolute subgroup bias and size. Not a selection criterion. Report original Gate 2 Spearman(sigma/mu,absolute lifetime error) by subset from seed101 M1p outer windows; assess degeneracy and avoid interpreting numerical noise as calibrated uncertainty.
official: Historically accessed official test excluded from this development experiment. Freeze final method, endpoint handling for short prefixes, and final recipe separately before any release.
